title: Chest pain
text: Stop all activity and sit the person down to rest; keep them calm and still.
Ask about the pain and check for warning signs: pressure, spread to arm, neck or jaw, sweating, nausea, breathlessness.
Give aspirin only if the mission protocol covers it and there is no allergy; never delay the call for help over medicine.
Get the crew medical officer and the emergency loop at once; prepare for CPR if they collapse.

citations.source: American Heart Association guidance: heart-attack warning signs and emergency response.
